categories.main_business_segments: Zhou Hei Ya International Holdings Company Limited primarily operates in the production and retail of casual braised food products. The company runs a dual business model combining self-operated stores and franchise operations, focusing on expanding its retail network and brand influence in the Chinese braised delicacy market.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes strict quality control and food safety throughout its supply chain, including raw material procurement, production, processing, and distribution. It employs lean management and continuous improvement platforms to enhance production efficiency and has invested in upgrading processing facilities and equipment optimization. The product development focuses on unique flavor profiles and innovation in product categories, including vacuum-sealed and bulk braised products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Zhou Hei Ya targets general consumers of casual braised food in China, with a strategic focus on young consumers and members to enhance brand engagement and loyalty. The company also serves offline supermarket channels and e-commerce platforms, expanding its reach beyond its own stores. Its products cater to diverse consumer needs, including mid-to-low price ranges and convenience-oriented bulk products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s headquarters and principal operations are in Wuhan, Hubei Province, China, with a significant retail presence nationwide across China. It also has a principal place of business in Hong Kong and is exploring overseas market opportunities to promote Chinese braised food culture internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhou Hei Ya operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on production, processing, and retail distribution of braised food products. It manages an integrated supply chain including procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and retail operations, with a strong emphasis on supply chain efficiency and quality control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include enhancing single-store profitability, comprehensive brand upgrades, product innovation focusing on classic and new flavors, and digital transformation for membership and private domain operations. It emphasizes organizational empowerment, cost reduction, efficiency improvement, and supply chain integration. R&D efforts focus on product structure optimization and expanding consumption scenarios with new product formats.
categories.revenue_model: Zhou Hei Ya generates revenue primarily through product sales at self-operated and franchised retail stores, as well as through sales in offline supermarket channels and e-commerce platforms. The company also benefits from membership-driven marketing activities and promotional campaigns to boost sales and customer loyalty.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Zhou Hei Ya positions itself as a leading national brand in the Chinese braised delicacy market. It emphasizes differentiated competitive advantages through unique flavors, product innovation, and strong brand recognition, aiming to reclaim industry leadership amid fierce market competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, the Group reported revenue of RMB 2,451.0 million, a 10.7% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit of RMB 98.2 million, down 15.0%. The gross profit margin improved to 56.8%. The company operates over 3,000 stores nationwide and maintains net assets of RMB 3,626.5 million. It is focused on sustainable growth, improving operational efficiency, and expanding its market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhou Hei Ya’s value proposition centers on delivering high-quality, uniquely flavored casual braised food products with a distinctive 'numb, spicy, sweet' flavor profile. The company differentiates itself through strict quality control, product innovation, diversified product offerings including vacuum-sealed and bulk products, and a strong brand identity as 'the Chinese Braised Delicacy.' It also emphasizes superior customer experience, targeted marketing to young consumers, and a robust membership system to enhance loyalty.
